memo:
THIS TURN: Play Training Center (it enters untapped because we have 2+ opponents). In main phase 1, cast Taigam, Sidisi's Hand. Pay with 3 of the 4 floating colourless from Mana Drain for the generic, plus Darkslick Shores (B) and Volcanic Island (U). The fourth floating mana is lost; that is fine. Taigam enters tapped (Authority of the Consuls), but its upkeep trigger still fires in every extra upkeep. Attack P3 with Obeka, Splitter of Seconds. All opposing creatures are tapped, so it should hit for 11: 11 upkeeps, 11 Ring of Evos Isle counters (Obeka becomes 22/25), and 11 Taigam picks. Picks go to hand and are not draws, so Orcish Bowmasters can't punish them. Taigam pick priority: Fierce Guardianship, Counterspell, Swan Song, Deflecting Swat, Psychic Paper, Cyclonic Rift, then lands. In main phase 2, cast only cheap protection. Keep UU and {2} open.

TARGET: Obeka at 22/25 with counter backup plus hexproof mana. Taigam alive with a full graveyard for its -X/-X.

WIN PATH: P3 takes about 16 commander damage; next turn's hit kills them. After that, each 22+ power hit is lethal commander damage to P1 or P2, one per turn. Opponents are 2+ turns from killing us.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2
- P3: Lathliss and likely Crux of Fate. Attack them now, kill them next turn.
- P1: 5 open lands, counters and Blasphemous Act (Obeka survives it at 25 toughness; Taigam dies), Sauron coming. Counter Sauron.
- P2: control with 1 open land. Respect Swords to Plowshares; leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Spot removal on Obeka: Ring of Evos Isle hexproof ({2}: Fellwar Stone plus a land). Crux of Fate or Toxic Deluge: counters picked by Taigam. Blocker next turn: Taigam ({B}, tap, exile X cards from graveyard) gives -X/-X.

HOLD: Fellwar Stone plus one land for hexproof, and UU for counters. Hold Endless Evil; never put it on a legend (Obeka, Taigam).

REPLAN IF: Taigam is countered: still attack P3. Obeka is removed: recast her for 6. Blockers are flashed in after attacks: keep attacking; menace needs two blockers and Obeka survives the block.

memo:
THIS TURN: Mana is 7: Xander's Lounge, Mountain, Sol Ring (2), Arcane Signet, Otawara, Soaring City, plus the Treasure Token. Angel of Destiny can win on P1's next turn. Battle Angels of Tyr with myriad (5 to each of us three) plus Destiny's double strike puts P1 past 55, and the player Destiny attacked loses. Court of Ire must fire in Obeka's extra upkeeps today.
1. Play any land Bonehoard Dracosaur exiled.
2. Main phase 1: cast Court of Ire ({3}{R}{R}) using Mountain {R}, Arcane Signet {R}, Sol Ring and Treasure. We become monarch.
3. Attack P4 with Obeka, Splitter of Seconds alone; she has menace. Dracosaur stays home. If P4 double-blocks, kill Bloodline Keeper (Cruel Celebrant drains us for 1).
4. Each extra upkeep, Court of Ire deals 7, in this order: Angel of Destiny, Battle Angels of Tyr, then Muldrotha, the Gravetide. Teval has shroud, so don't target it.
5. Main phase 2: spend exiled lands and Treasures on exiled cards, then Phyrexian Arena only with spare mana. Keep Xander's Lounge {B} and Otawara {U} untapped for Drown in the Loch.

TARGET: Court of Ire held as monarch, Phyrexian Arena running, Obeka growing. Missing: Psychic Paper, Wizard's Staff, Roaming Throne, Swiftfoot Boots, Wrecking Ball Arm.

WIN PATH: Court of Ire firing 7 each upkeep, multiplied by Obeka hits, plus her commander damage. About 3 turns. P1 wins next turn if Destiny lives.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2 > P4
- P1: Angel of Destiny alt-win. Court kills Destiny first.
- P2: Jarad drain, Muldrotha recursion, Living Death. Hold Drown in the Loch.
- P4: weakest blockers, so it is our attack target. Otherwise don't kill their creatures.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Destiny and Battle Angels: Court of Ire. A P2 spell with mana value ≤ their graveyard count (4 now; Living Death is 3): Drown in the Loch. Drown can't reach Destiny or Muldrotha. Never chump-block.

HOLD: Drown in the Loch with {U}{B}. Arcane Adaptation stays in hand.

REPLAN IF: Obeka is blocked or killed. Court then fires only at our next upkeep, too late. On P1's turn, Bonehoard Dracosaur blocks Battle Angels of Tyr (5/5; first strike kills it), which keeps P1 under 55. Combat damage to us costs the monarchy, so Court deals only 2. A wipe resolves.

TARGET: P4 eliminated; Court of Ire plus Phyrexian Arena, monarch held, Obeka huge. Missing: Psychic Paper, Wizard's Staff, Roaming Throne, Swiftfoot Boots.

WIN PATH: Repeat the menace swing at whoever can't double-block, each hit firing Court of Ire 7×N. About 2 turns for the table.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P2 > P1
- P4: Bloodline Keeper snowball, Vito combo risk. Kill them today.
- P2: 14 power, Jarad sac-drains with Muldrotha recursion. Court takes Muldrotha and Jarad next.
- P1: empty board. It is our free attack lane; leave them otherwise.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Living Death or another P2 spell with mana value ≤4: Drown in the Loch. Don't chump-block (Cruel Celebrant).

HOLD: Arcane Adaptation. Drown in the Loch, with {U}{B} if any is left.

REPLAN IF: Obeka is removed or blocked: Court of Ire fires next upkeep only, at Bloodline Keeper's line. P4 dies early: send the remaining Courts at Muldrotha, Jarad, then P2's face.

In main 1, cast Super Intelligence on Obeka, Splitter of Seconds ({U} from Darkslick Shores). Attack P4. Edgar Markov is P4's only creature, so menace means she can't be blocked. A 4-damage hit gives 4 extra upkeeps, each drawing 2 (Avarice Amulet and Super Intelligence), so 8 cards. In main 2, keep Swamp and Badlands untapped for Infernal Grasp. With the other 4 mana, first cast any drawn upkeep engine or doubler. Otherwise cast Psychic Paper ({2}) and equip it ({2}), naming "Grizzly Bears" with type Wizard. At cleanup, discard down to 7 in this order: surplus lands (keep one land for next turn), then Sphere of Annihilation, then the weakest spells. Never discard Otawara, Soaring City or Infernal Grasp.

TARGET: Obeka as a Wizard via Psychic Paper, plus Wizard's Staff, Roaming Throne (naming Wizard), Plargg and Nassari, Wrecking Ball Arm and Swiftfoot Boots.

WIN PATH: Hit every turn and turn the draws into engines and doublers. The finish is 21 commander damage on P4 (8 after this hit) or engine overload, around turns 15-17. P1 flies for about 7 a turn; we're at 38 and not under lethal threat.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P4 > P2
- P1: 7 flying power, Giada growing every Angel, 6 cards. Kill Battle Angels of Tyr.
- P4: Edgar eminence and the Vito combo. Attack them.
- P2: slow. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Infernal Grasp (lose 2) goes to Vito or Bloodthirsty Conqueror if P4 casts one. Otherwise use it on Battle Angels of Tyr at P1's beginning of combat. Otawara, Soaring City's Channel ({2}{U}) is for Exquisite Blood or Archangel of Thune. It is unaffordable this round, since only 2 mana stays open. Don't chump-block into P4's death triggers.

HOLD: Infernal Grasp with Swamp and Badlands. Sphere of Annihilation (X=0) is for Edgar's tokens if any appear, unless we have to discard it.

REPLAN IF:
- A second creature joins P4's side before blocks: menace can be blocked, so attack P1 or P2 instead.
- Obeka dies: give Avarice Amulet to P2.
- Battle Angels of Tyr gets indestructible: hold Grasp for P4.

memo:
THIS TURN: 1. Play Bottomless Vault (it enters tapped; never untap it, so it stores {B} each upkeep). 2. Tap Sol Ring for Talisman of Creativity (2), then tap Talisman for {C}, which deals no damage. 3. Cast Obeka, Splitter of Seconds (6 with tax) from Talisman, Badlands, Fellwar Stone, Darkslick Shores, Morphic Pool and Swamp. For colours use Badlands or Fellwar for {R}, Darkslick or Morphic for {U}, and Swamp for {B}. That taps us out. She can't attack this turn. She blocks ground creatures only: no reach, and menace does nothing on defence. Don't cast Dimir Signet or Chronozoa.

TARGET: Next turn we have 9 mana (8 sources plus 1 Vault counter). Equip Psychic Paper (2, type Wizard, harmless name) and Avarice Amulet (2) on Obeka, then attack P1. Cast Demonic Tutor (2) for Wizard's Staff or Wrecking Ball Arm. Keep {U}{U} open for Counterspell or Mana Drain.

WIN PATH: An unblockable 4-power Obeka gets 4 upkeeps a hit. That's 4 Avarice Amulet draws and 4 Vault counters (the Vault stays tapped). Add doublers, then win by commander damage or engine overload in about 5 turns. P1 is fastest at 6 flying power; we're at 33, so we're safe this round.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P4 > P2
- P1: Giada, a growing Exemplar of Light and 6 cards. Attack them.
- P4: Edgar Markov's eminence still works from the command zone, and the Vito combo is their win. Counter its pieces.
- P2: slow Six graveyard deck. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Vito, Exquisite Blood or Bloodthirsty Conqueror on the stack: Counterspell or Mana Drain.
- A resolved Archangel of Thune or Avacyn: Cyclonic Rift (2).
- A wide board: overloaded Cyclonic Rift (7) at the end of the turn before ours.
- Don't chump-block; it feeds P4's death triggers.

HOLD: Counterspell, Mana Drain and Cyclonic Rift from next turn on. Keep 2 blue sources open after equips (Darkslick Shores, Morphic Pool, Talisman of Creativity, Fellwar Stone).

REPLAN IF:
- Obeka is countered (tax is +4 either way): next turn cast Demonic Tutor, hold counters, and recast her only when P2 is tapped out.
- Obeka is removed: same plan, and save Mana Drain to protect the recast.
- P1 casts Akroma's Will or swings wide: Rift the biggest attacker.

WIN PATH: Two more unblockable hits kill P4 by commander damage: 5 now, then 10+ next turn, then a third hit. Silent Arbiter holds every crack-back to one attacker. Their biggest single hits are Edgar Markov at about 8 and Archangel of Thune at 6-7, so we survive about 2 turns at 19.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P1 > P2. P4: Edgar Markov's first strike, Blade of the Bloodchief, Banner draws and the Vito combo risk; attack them. P1: Archangel of Thune grows on every lifelink hit, and Swords to Plowshares or Path to Exile can kill Arbiter; second target. P2: slow Gitrog value; leave alone.

Bitter Triumph goes to Vito, Bloodthirsty Conqueror or Archangel of Thune, mostly on our turn. It can't hit Exquisite Blood. Every kill feeds Blade of the Bloodchief.

HOLD: 4 mana for Aetherize through the opponents' turns. Hold Roaming Throne until a Wizard hub arrives. Discard Throne to Bitter Triumph if our life is under 12.

- P4: tokens and a drain combo. Answer Vito or Exquisite Blood on sight.
- P2: graveyard value, slower. Leave them alone for now.

- Baneslayer Angel: Legacy's Allure at 6 counters, Torch Song at 6, or Drown in the Loch once P1's graveyard has 5 or more cards.
- Giada: Drown in the Loch once P1's graveyard has 2 or more cards.
- Vito or Exquisite Blood: Torch Song or Drown in the Loch.
- Obeka cannot block fliers (Baneslayer Angel, Giada, Teval). It may block Six.
- Never chump-block into P4.
- Attack with Obeka (menace) only at a player whose two untapped blockers deal 4 or less combined. P4 qualifies now.

HOLD: Drown in the Loch, Aetherize and Frenzied Fugue. Keep Baxter Building for next turn's land drop.

- Obeka is removed: recast it for 6.
- P1's graveyard reaches 2 or more cards: Drown in the Loch on Giada.
- An alpha strike threatens 25 or more damage: hold Aetherize (4 mana including U).

memo:
THIS TURN: Accept the Torch Song verse counter. Play Baxter Building; it enters untapped and taps for {C}. Main 1: cast Legacy's Allure, paying UU with Underground Sea and Volcanic Island. At beginning of combat, cast Untimely Malfunction ({1}{R}: Luxury Suite for R, Baxter Building for generic) so Welcoming Vampire and P4's Vampire Token can't block. Attack P4 with Obeka, Splitter of Seconds for 2 extra upkeeps. In each, add a Torch Song verse counter and a Legacy's Allure treasure counter. Main 2: sacrifice Legacy's Allure (2 counters) to take Giada, Font of Hope permanently. Swamp stays open but casts nothing in hand.

TARGET: Torch Song at 4+ and Frenzied Fugue for next turn. Find Court of Ire, Virtue of Persistence, Phyrexian Arena, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.

WIN PATH: Obeka hits every turn for extra upkeeps, Torch Song burns, and Court of Ire with the monarchy closes. P2 and P1 need about 4+ turns.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P4
- P2: 11 power, Teval engine, Tatyova draw. Torch Song on Teval next turn.
- P1: Battle Angels of Tyr, 5/5 flier. Take Giada today, Frenzied Fugue the Angel next turn.
- P4: small board. Kill Vito, Exquisite Blood or Skullclamp on sight.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Teval: Torch Song ({2}{R}, 4+ counters), not castable this turn.
- Battle Angels of Tyr: Frenzied Fugue ({3}{R}), Torch Song at 5+, or Drown in the Loch once P1's graveyard has 4+ cards.
- Six: Drown in the Loch (MV 3, P2 graveyard 3).
- Never chump-block into P4. Crack-back is at most 21 into our 38, so we are safe.

HOLD: Aetherize and Drown in the Loch. Neither is castable this turn (only Swamp is open). Next turn, Frenzied Fugue (4) and Torch Song (3) don't both fit in 5 mana; choose one.

REPLAN IF:
- Legacy's Allure is targeted by removal: sacrifice it in response for Giada.
- Untimely Malfunction is answered and P4 blocks: still attack, since Obeka survives 3 damage, and keep Legacy's Allure to grow.
- Legacy's Allure gets fewer than 2 counters: keep it.

- P2: biggest board and the Teval engine. Drown Teval or Fugue next.
- P4: drain combo risk. Counter Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose.

- Angel of Destiny: Torch Song at 7.
- Battle Angels of Tyr: Frenzied Fugue next turn.

THIS TURN: Play Rogue's Passage as the land drop and keep Otawara, Soaring City in hand. Attack P1 with Obeka, Splitter of Seconds. It is not summoning sick, because it was cast last turn. It has menace, and P1's only untapped creature is Battle Angels of Tyr (Giada is tapped), so P1 cannot block it. Six (P2) and Edgar Markov (P4) are also alone. The hit gives 2 extra upkeeps, which do nothing yet. In main phase 2, cast Vedalken Mastermind ({U}{U}: Morphic Pool plus Exotic Orchard, taking blue via P2's Island). Keep Swamp plus Rogue's Passage up for Go for the Throat. Talisman of Creativity is a spare mana. Mastermind is summoning sick, so it cannot use its {U},{T} ability until our next turn.

TARGET: Court of Ire, Virtue of Persistence, Phyrexian Arena or Frenzied Fugue on the battlefield before Obeka connects, then Extravagant Replication copying it. Diabolic Intent (sacrifice Vedalken Mastermind or a borrowed creature) fetches Court of Ire.

WIN PATH: Long game. Build the upkeep engine, then connect with Obeka every turn. P1's clock on us is 7 flying power and growing, so about 5 turns.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P4 > P2. P1: Giada snowballs Angels and already has 7 flying power; kill Giada. P4: Edgar tokens and the Vito instant-win risk; kill drainers on sight. P2: slow graveyard value; leave alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Go for the Throat: if P1 casts an Angel, kill Giada in response so the Angel enters without counters. If P4 casts Vito, Bloodthirsty Conqueror or Cordial Vampire, kill that instead. Otherwise kill Giada at P1's end step. Otawara's channel from hand ({2}{U} with Obeka out) answers Exquisite Blood or Skullclamp. Six wears Lightning Greaves (shroud) and cannot be targeted. Greaves can move to Teval for {0}.

HOLD: Otawara, Soaring City in hand for its channel. {1}{B} (Swamp plus Rogue's Passage) for Go for the Throat. Extravagant Replication until it has an engine piece to copy.

REPLAN IF: An opponent gets two untapped creatures, so menace can be blocked. A wipe hits. Vito or Exquisite Blood lands. Obeka is removed: recast it ({2} more) only when Go for the Throat mana still fits.

memo:
THIS TURN: P4's main 2, with Bloodletter of Aclazotz on the stack. Let it resolve and do not use Get Out on it. It only doubles life loss during P4's turn, and P4 should die on our turn. Hold all 4 mana through the P1 and P2 turns. If P1 casts Farewell, Austere Command or another wipe, respond with Get Out ({U}{U}: Underground Sea plus one Talisman of Creativity for U, taking 1 damage). Return Court of Ire and Extravagant Replication to hand.

TARGET: Two or more Courts of Ire with the monarchy. Next tutor targets: Virtue of Persistence and Phyrexian Arena.

WIN PATH: Our upkeep:
- Court of Ire deals 7 to P4 (25→18).
- Replication must copy Court of Ire, never a Talisman.

Attack with the unblockable Obeka, Splitter of Seconds. Target P4, or whoever took the monarchy (that retakes it before the extra upkeeps).
- Extra upkeep 1: two Courts deal 14 to P4, and Replication makes a third Court.
- Extra upkeep 2: three Courts. Finish P4 with the first trigger, then aim the rest at P1.

P4 dies this turn. P1 dies next turn.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P1 > P2.
- P4: Exquisite Blood plus Bloodletter; Vito or Bloodthirsty Conqueror wins instantly. Burn them out first.
- P1: Herald of War, and likely wipes. They are next.
- P2: Teval may steal the monarchy. Leave them be; retake it with Obeka.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Wipe on our enchantments: Get Out bounces them.
- Vito or Conqueror cast before our turn: Get Out counters it.
- Monarchy lost: Obeka's hit on the holder.
- Big attack on our turn: Aetherspouts, once we have 5 mana after untapping.

HOLD: Get Out, plus Underground Sea and Talismans for UU. Hold Aetherspouts for an alpha strike.

REPLAN IF:
- Court of Ire is destroyed: cast it from hand again next turn ({3}{R}{R}) before combat.
- Obeka dies: recast it (tax +2) and fire the Courts anyway.
- P4 gains a lot of life: keep every Court trigger on P4 until they are dead.

memo:
THIS TURN: Resolve the upkeep triggers. On each Thassa, God of the Sea scry, keep counterspells (Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, Counterspell) and bottom lands. Play any land drawn. At beginning of combat, pay {1}{U} to Thassa so Obeka, Splitter of Seconds can't be blocked. Attack P1 only, with Obeka alone: 24 power against 6 life. Gisa, Glorious Resurrector and Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose stay home. That leaves 5 mana: hold {2} for Ring of Evos Isle hexproof. Don't activate Vito's lifelink ({3}{B}{B}). Main 2: cast nothing. Our lands stay tapped until our next turn, so the leftover 5 must cover P2's turn. On P2's upkeep, cast Cyclonic Rift ({1}{U}) on Enduring Tenacity and keep {2} for hexproof. If hexproof was already spent this turn, only 3 remain: Rift anyway (1 left over).

TARGET: P1 dead now. Obeka near 48 power after 24 extra upkeeps, surviving to our next turn.

WIN PATH: Next turn, pay Thassa {1}{U} and Propaganda's {2}, keep {2} for hexproof (6 of 7 mana). Obeka hits P2 for 21+ commander damage and wins. P2 cannot kill us from 11 in one turn if we block well.

THREAT ORDER: P1 > P2. P1: 25 power, lethal on us next turn, at 6 life; kill now. P2: drain engine (Y'shtola, Night's Blessed, Enduring Tenacity, lifelink Hero Token) plus removal; blunt their turn, kill next turn.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Answer removal on Obeka with Ring hexproof {2}. Answer Enduring Tenacity with Cyclonic Rift. Obeka stays tapped through P2's turn. Gisa blocks the Hero Token or Y'shtola; Vito blocks Archmage Emeritus. Never block Baleful Strix (deathtouch).

HOLD: {2} for hexproof. Hold Estrid's Invocation (no Court of Ire to copy).

REPLAN IF: P1 survives: on P1's turn, Cyclonic Rift Witch-king of Angmar and chump the big Nazgûl with Vito. Obeka is removed: recast her (6 mana) next turn. Tenacity is already gone: Rift the Hero Token.

Don't chump-block with Knights we don't need to: each Knight adds 1 to every Embereth hit. Don't let a creature connect on us, because that takes the monarch.

HOLD: All 7 mana for Aetherspouts plus 2. Keep Ring of Xathrid, Cast Through Time and Recurring Insight in hand. Access Tunnel is next turn's land drop.

- We lose the monarch: Ire deals only 2 and Embereth deals nothing, so recount.
- A wipe kills our Knight Tokens: fall back to Obeka attacks to regain the monarch.
- P2 drops below 0 from another source: aim everything at P1.

THIS TURN: 1. In upkeep, cast the Fantastic Elasticity rebound for free in graveyard mode and return Delayed Blast Fireball to hand. The cast amasses P1 an Army. 2. In main phase 1, foretell Delayed Blast Fireball for {2} with Access Tunnel and Bojuka Bog. 3. Cast nothing else. Keep 6 up: Volcanic Island, Morphic Pool, Shipwreck Marsh, Arcane Signet, Talisman of Creativity, Fellwar Stone. Red comes from Volcanic Island, Arcane Signet and Fellwar Stone. 4. A foretold card can't be cast the turn it's foretold. On P1's turn, ideally at their beginning of combat after they spend mana, cast Delayed Blast Fireball from exile for {4}{R}{R}. It deals 5 to each opponent and their creatures. That kills P3, Atarka, Nazgûl, Orcish Siegemaster, Y'shtola and the Orc Army. Its cast amasses first, but the Army is only 2/2. Latest window: P3's upkeep.

TARGET: P3 dead and boards cleared. Next turn: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds ({4} plus {2} tax = 6) and Lizard Blades (2). Turn after: reconfigure Lizard Blades onto Obeka ({2}), Thassa, God of the Sea ({3}) and Thassa's unblockable ({1}{U}). Missing: Cast Through Time, Galvanoth, Demonic Tutor.

WIN PATH: Unblockable double-strike Obeka, with World at War cast precombat so it rebounds in her extra upkeep. About 3–4 turns.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P2.
- P3: 5 life, Atarka double strike, lethal pressure. Kill them with the Fireball.
- P1: Sauron, wheels, every spell amasses. Sweep, never target Sauron.
- P2: 49 life, slow drain. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: The Fireball answers Atarka and P1's small creatures. Sauron (7/6) and Miirym (6/6) survive it, so use Toxic Deluge or Damnation later. Enduring Tenacity returns as an enchantment and drains on P2's lifegain. Don't feed P1 cheap spells.

HOLD: All 6 for the Fireball. Hold World at War, Thassa, God of the Sea, Theater of Horrors and Lizard Blades.

REPLAN IF:
- Fireball is countered: rebuild with Obeka next turn.
- P3 dies first: cast the Fireball at P2's end step.
- P3 makes an instant-speed hasty threat: fire immediately.

1) Cast Fire Covenant first. Pay with Badlands (R), Luxury Suite (B) and Rogue's Passage (C). Sol Ring makes only colourless, so it can't pay for B and R.
- Pay X=19 life (30 to 11).
- Divide the damage: 5 to The Scarab God, 4 to the Kishla Skimmer token, 2 to each of the five Zombie Druid tokens.
- Storm-Kiln Artist makes a Treasure.
2) Play Bojuka Bog targeting P2. It exiles The Scarab God before its end-step return, plus their whole graveyard. This makes one Teval Zombie.
3) No attacks. Pass.

TARGET: P2 holds only Teval, the Balanced Scale, Aftermath Analyst and one Zombie, with an empty graveyard. Then add Aqueous Form on Obeka, Splitter of Seconds, and Cast Through Time or Galvanoth from draws.

WIN PATH: Once stable, swing with Storm-Kiln Artist (about 8 power) and an unblockable Obeka, Splitter of Seconds. P2 at 31 dies in about 3-4 turns. Fiery Confluence or Court of Ire speed this up.

THREAT ORDER: P2 only. Wide board, a 13/13 flying commander, a recursion engine. Stance: sweep now, block every turn.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Teval, the Balanced Scale (13/13 flying): Baleful Strix blocks it; deathtouch kills it. At 11 life, Strix is our lifeline: an unblocked Teval kills us.
- Zombie: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds blocks it.
- Aftermath Analyst: Storm-Kiln Artist blocks it.
- Don't remove their cards one at a time; each graveyard exit makes a Zombie.

HOLD: Keep Aqueous Form while Obeka, Splitter of Seconds is a needed blocker. Never tap Baleful Strix.

REPLAN IF:
- Fire Covenant is countered: still play Bojuka Bog, then chump the biggest attackers and keep Baleful Strix for Teval.
- Baleful Strix is removed: chump everything else. Teval's 13 is lethal at 11, so dig for a wipe or a flying blocker.
- We draw Toxic Deluge, Damnation or Evacuation: cast it before anything else.
